narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms developed across northeast and east central Oklahoma during the morning of the 8th, to the north of a stationary frontal boundary as an upper level disturbance moved into the area. Meanwhile, a well-organized squall line moved into east central and southeastern Oklahoma from the west. High water content in the air across the region promoted locally heavy rainfall from the strongest activity, which subsequently resulted in some flash flooding. The strongest thunderstorms also produced damaging wind and hail.
ev: Portions of several roads on the southeast side of Muskogee were flooded.
Portions of several roads on the northeast side of McAlester were flooded.
Portions of several roads were flooded in Gore.
